dialogues.speaker: "Thelxie" Development Log (III)
dialogues.text: ...I've already spent more time than planned on the transcription module. The work on Thelxie's main body will be affected if I keep at this. I'll have to put it on hold...

dialogues.speaker: "Thelxie" Development Log (III)
dialogues.text: ...Although the diving helmet can still be used to decipher Thelxie's output signal, it'll probably be unintelligible to everyone else. What a pity...

dialogues.speaker: "Thelxie" Development Log (III)
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry for not being able to give you a voice, Thelxie...
